dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Ah, Mamere told me about the situation. It was the first time that the kid talked that much...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Anyway, Monsieur Neuvillette is very concerned about the matter. I heard that the Marechaussee Phantom has already sent someone to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for your help! Right, a—as a token of gratitude, please, take this!
